outcome: wound complications (wound infection, wound breakdown, antibiotic treatment, surgical intervention)
other symptoms of pelvic floor disorders
cohort: The study included 332 patients with an obstetric anal sphincter injury (OASI) who were evaluated in a postpartum pelvic floor healing clinic between November 1, 2020, and May 16, 2023.
finding: Older maternal age was associated with wound complications after OASI, while peripartum antibiotics were protective, and patients with wound complications were more likely to report symptoms of pelvic floor disorders.
mod_finding: On univariate analysis, having an episiotomy was associated with an increased likelihood of wound complications after OASI.
